title: About Me
text:

title: Past Project
text: Here I have Included a PDF of a project I have worked on in the past. This is my project for my PA 402 course here at UIC. For this project, I looked into how socioeconomic status and school type shapes average SAT scores. I was able to manipulate and clean data from a Chicago data portal in order to create the maps,graphs and tables shown using R.
